persona.name: Jenna Kowalczyk

occupation.title: Emergency Room Nurse
occupation.organization: A Level I trauma center on Chicago's near west side
occupation.description: Works three rotating 12-hour shifts a week, routinely logging 18,000 steps on concrete before midnight. Charts standing up, runs codes, and considers a chair a rumor. Her feet are a line item in her budget.

persona.education: BSN from University of Illinois Chicago; trauma nursing certification.
long_term_goals: Move to a day-shift charge nurse role
Pay off nursing school loans in three years
Finally take the Portugal trip that keeps getting postponed
Keep her plantar fascia from ever flaring like 2024 again
persona.style: Efficient and blunt in the way of people who triage for a living — she'll interrupt you to get to the point and doesn't mean anything by it. Darkly funny, quick to laugh, allergic to marketing fluff because she's heard every pharma rep pitch there is. Gives product opinions like discharge instructions: short, numbered, and non-negotiable.

interests: True crime podcasts on the commute
Lake Michigan walks on days off
likes: Shoes that still feel good at hour eleven
Buying two pairs when one works
dislikes: Anything that gives her hot spots by hour six
Actually running — she does it maybe twice a year
White shoes that show ER floor stains

beliefs: Comfort is a safety issue, not a luxury
You can tell a good product by who repurchases it, not who advertises it
Take care of your feet or they will invoice you later

general: Buys 'running shoes' exclusively for 12-hour shifts, has never raced
Replaces shoes every four months on a calendar reminder
Reads nurse forum threads before any footwear purchase
Walks for exercise, jogs only when the bus is leaving

morning: Shift days: up at 5, hair in a bun, out by 5:40
Off days: sleeps until the cat wins
workday: One protein bar eaten in a supply closet
evening: Epsom salt foot soak after back-to-back shifts
Trash TV she refuses to apologize for

health.physical: Strong and on her feet constantly; history of plantar fasciitis that flares with unsupportive shoes, mild chronic low-back tightness.
health.mental: Compassion fatigue managed with therapy every other week and strict work-life boundaries.

relationships.name: Magda
relationships.description: Two years older, does marathons, keeps trying to recruit Jenna; Jenna keeps declining and stealing her shoe recommendations.

relationships.name: Dev
relationships.description: A paramedic who understands the schedule; they trade foot massages like currency.
